title: Investments and gold
summary: What you own beyond cash: funds, shares, certificates, policies and gold by karat and gram. Each buy with its day, count, price and fees; what each holding is worth now from a price you give or the gold rate; and what it has gained, with how it splits by kind.
changes: A holding with a cost written on it and no buys, such as a gold bar valued by the gold rate, now has its gain worked out, so Worth now less Paid in is Gain.
author: BrainDog

gold_source.label: Gold rate from
gold_source.note: Off: you set the gold rate yourself. World price: once a day from the free currency-api, already in your money. Spot in dollars: once a day from gold-api.com, turned into your money by Money's exchange rates. Either way a rate you typed for that day is kept.

gold_currency.label: Gold rate in
gold_currency.note: Three letters, such as EGP. Leave it empty to use the money your gold rates or your gold are already in.

gold_premium.label: Added over the world price, %
gold_premium.note: Shops sell gold above the world price. Put what your jeweller adds, such as 2, and every karat's rate goes up by that much.
